tally.headline: 0 of 2 gradeable claims held up, 2 did not

implied_side.book: captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetMGM
implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 1.7 points toward Texas of the quote EdgeDesk captured at captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetMGM. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 45.9 sat 6.4 points above the captured total of 39.5.

closing_line.note: The line moved 1.5 points AWAY from the side EdgeDesk’s number leaned. The market went the other way.

reasons: None of the mechanism EdgeDesk named before kickoff could be graded against the statistics published for this game. The scoreboard is not evidence about a mechanism nobody could observe.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

variance_markers.label: A two-turnover edge
variance_markers.text: Oklahoma Sooners won the turnover battle by two, which is worth roughly a touchdown of scoreboard on average and is largely noise game to game.

variance_markers.label: 2 non-offensive or return scores
variance_markers.text: Points that arrived without an offensive drive. They count the same on the scoreboard and belong to a different distribution from the one the model prices.

variance_markers.label: A 3-point game
variance_markers.text: A game this close is decided inside the noise of any projection. Whichever way it fell, it is weak evidence about either team.

verdict.line: The number did not land, in a game the statistics cannot grade the reasoning on. It goes in the record and teaches little.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 2 published claims said the same thing: EdgeDesk prices this game at Oklahoma +9.7 with a fair total of 45.9, which makes Texas the better team here by that margin on this field. EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma +9.7 where the market has Oklahoma +8.0 at captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetMGM — a 1.7 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: Texas Longhorns lost by 3 where EdgeDesk projected a 9.7-point edge. Texas Longhorns lost by 3.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk named Texas as better in market and the game went the other way, across 2 separate published claims. One game does not overturn a season-long rating, but this is the direction to watch: Oklahoma Sooners won the game outright
lessons.suggested_investigation: These claims carried 11.4 points of the published number between them and were contradicted. Check whether the same category has been contradicted in other games this season before touching anything.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 8 of the claims in this article rested on model, defence, passing, rushing, matchup, special_teams.
lessons.actual_result: None of them could be graded: no single-game statistic in EdgeDesk’s vocabulary observes this driver; the box score for this game published no yards per play.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk prices these games partly on signals it has no way to observe afterwards. That is not an error in the model — it is a gap in the audit, and it means the platform cannot tell, from results alone, whether those parts of the number are earning their weight.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Consider whether a postgame data source exists for model, defence, passing.

lessons.pregame_expectation: EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma +9.7 where the market has Oklahoma +8.0 at captured consensus (stale) · 1 book · best at BetMGM — a 1.7 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: Texas Longhorns lost by 3. the result landed on the market’s side of the disagreement
lessons.lesson: The market had the better estimate here. EdgeDesk’s disagreement was not information on this game, and the honest reading is that the price already contained what the model thought it had found.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Track disagreements of this size across the season. The question is not whether one landed; it is whether the class of them has any edge at all.
